decision_target: Whether the charity can claim Gift Aid on a donation

atoms.proposition: The organisation claiming Gift Aid is recognised as a charity or community amateur sports club (CASC) for tax purposes by HMRC
atoms.entity_scope: the charity or CASC making the claim

atoms.proposition: The donation was made by an individual (not a company or other entity)
The donor has paid at least as much in Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax in the relevant tax year as the amount the charity wants to claim in Gift Aid on that donation
The donor has made a Gift Aid declaration giving the charity permission to claim Gift Aid on the donation
The donation was NOT made through Payroll Giving
The donation is NOT a payment for goods or services, and is NOT made because the charity or CASC bought goods or services from the donor
The donor does NOT receive a benefit in connection with the donation that exceeds the permitted limit
The donation is NOT a donation of shares
The donation was NOT made via a charity card or voucher (e.g. a CAF voucher)

scope_issues: The customer has multiple donors making both recurring (direct debit) and one-off donations; each individual donation must be assessed separately against all conditions, so a single yes/no answer cannot be given for the charity as a whole
The £260 payment from Robyn Ellis and her separate £20 cash gift are distinct transactions that may reach different conclusions under the same rules and must be assessed independently
limitations: The passages do not specify the exact monetary threshold above which a donor benefit disqualifies a donation (a7); only that a limit exists
The passages do not define what counts as a 'benefit' for the purposes of the benefit limit (a7)
The passages do not address mixed payments (part payment for goods/services, part genuine donation) or whether a partial Gift Aid claim is permissible
No guidance is provided in the passages on record-keeping requirements beyond the Gift Aid declaration itself
The passages do not address the process or timing requirements for Gift Aid declarations
